title: Wishlist
description: Customer wishlist containing products they want to purchase later. Supports named wishlists, public/private visibility, and multiple items. Used for gift registries and saved-for-later functionality.

user_id.description: Foreign key reference to the user who owns this wishlist

name.description: Name or title of the wishlist (e.g., Birthday Wishlist, Wedding Registry, My Favorites)

items.description: Array of product identifiers or names saved in this wishlist

is_public.description: Whether the wishlist is publicly visible and shareable, or private to the user

created_at.description: Timestamp when the wishlist was created
